title: Evening capture ritual - PM daily
body:
Evening capture ritual (quick brain dump)

Context: end-of-day capture for launch week. Keep rough, actionable, timestamped. Will triage in morning and push items to Linear/Jira.

---

Today highlights (03/12)
- 09:15 standup: SRE flagged a transient CUDA OOM during long-context tests (seq len 8k). Affected canary only.
- 11:30 PRD pass: tightened success metric language for model fallback (latency delta, failure rate cap).
- 14:00 call with Solutions Eng (Priya): customer A wants Private VPC checklist + onboarding timeline (2–3 weeks).
- 16:10 rollout dry-run: console rollout step 3 script failed due to permission scoping for service-account.
- 17:20 demo to growth: embeddings latency numbers look good, asked for per-route cost breakdown on dashboard.

Open questions / things to resolve
- OOM root cause: is this kernel selection issue (serving runtime) or bad batching policy? Need SRE/Serving pair. // Ping: @Ethan (SRE)
- Permission scoping: who owns SA policy for console deploys? (infra or platform eng?). Action: open small RFC.
- Customer A onboarding: do we have a templated checklist for air-gapped private? If not, draft ASAP.

Quick TODOs (triage and own)
- [ ] File a concise incident note for 09:15 OOM (include logs, sample request, model variant) — assign to Ethan + me — due tomorrow 10:30am.
- [ ] Update PRD section 4.2 to use absolute numbers not percentages (latency SLOs) — done draft, needs review by Priya.
- [ ] Create Private onboarding skeleton doc for Customer A (sections: infra reqs, certs/KMS, network, time estimates) — start tomorrow.
- [ ] Add dashboard card request to backlog: per-route token cost for embeddings — put under product-ops.
- [x] Demo prep deck updated (slides 2–4) — sent to Growth.

PRD edit notes (what I changed, why)
- Reworded "graceful fallback" to: "fallback must keep 95th-pct tail latency under X ms and preserve token-level continuity (no context drops)." Rationale: vague phrasing was causing ambiguous SRE runbook.
- Added acceptance test: run synthetic traffic at 1.2x expected peak for 30m with canary routing + measure error-rate.
- Added metric to track: upstream model variant substitutions per 10k requests (so we can reason about rollback sensitivity).

Stakeholder follow-ups (short windows)
- Priya Nair (Solutions Eng): follow-up on Customer A onboarding checklist — ping tomorrow 10:00 PT.
- Ethan Park (SRE): need logs + initial triage by EOD — otherwise escalate to oncall lead.
- Jenna (Growth): send the per-route cost ask + sample timeframe for dashboard card — by Friday.

Launch checklist (current state)
- Canary: wired (yes), smoke tests pass (mostly), OOM observed -> blocker.
- Rollout script: step 3 permission error -> blocker.
- Monitoring: dashboards in place for latency + errors, missing per-route cost -> low priority.
- Rollback plan: documented but not automated. Need an ops runbook to execute within 3 minutes.

Immediate mitigation ideas (temp)
- Force smaller batch-size for canary until kernel fix confirmed (reduce parallelism). Risk: higher per-token cost but buys stability.
- Add circuit-breaker at routing layer to divert traffic to older variant if OOM spikes above threshold.

Notes to self (ritual capture)
- Keep tomorrow morning focused: 09:00 sync with SRE/Serving to triage OOM, 10:00 check-in with Priya, 11:30 PRD review with product.
- When writing runbook for rollback: include CLI commands, telemetry query to verify, and a communication template for customers.
- Remember to surface the per-route cost ask in our product weekly sync (doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/metrics-requests).

Random scraps / brainstorms
- Could we expose a "safety headroom" toggle in Console that auto-limits batch size for canaries? Might be a fast UI + agent change (product + infra).
- For Private onboarding, pre-flight checklist could be a single downloadable zip with terraform skeleton, KMS integration notes, and sample NGINX ingress config. 

End-of-day quick rating (calm check)
- Energy: 6/10 (tired), Focus: 7/10, Biggest blocker: OOM + deploy permissions.

Next morning TODO (one-line)
1) Join 09:00 SRE triage. 2) Open RFC for SA scoping. 3) Draft Customer A onboarding outline.

---

This is personal scratchpad; will move actionable items to Linear tomorrow and convert long notes into a tidy PRD diff. Keep informal here so I don't lose context.
